{{Cheatsheet}}

Firefox is a free and open-source web browser by the Mozilla Foundation. This cheatsheet covers what most people reach for every day: the address bar, keyboard shortcuts, and the built-in <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:</syntaxhighlight> pages.

== Basic example: the address bar ==

The address bar is both a URL field and a search box — it guesses what you mean as you type:

{| class="wikitable"
! You type !! What happens
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>wikibase.ronzz.org</syntaxhighlight> || navigates there; the scheme (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>https://</syntaxhighlight>) is filled in for you
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>ronzz wiki</syntaxhighlight> || searches with your default engine; suggestions from history, bookmarks and open tabs drop down as you type
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>@wikipedia firefox</syntaxhighlight> || searches Wikipedia directly — <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>@</syntaxhighlight> lets you pick a search engine
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>^ronzz</syntaxhighlight> || only browsing history (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>^</syntaxhighlight>)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>*ronzz</syntaxhighlight> || only bookmarks (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>*</syntaxhighlight>)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>%ronzz</syntaxhighlight> || only open tabs (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>%</syntaxhighlight>)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>#ronzz</syntaxhighlight> || only titles and bookmark tags (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>#</syntaxhighlight>)
|}

Press <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+K</syntaxhighlight> / <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+K</syntaxhighlight> first to force the next thing you type to be a search.

== Keyboard shortcuts ==

=== Tabs and windows ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Action !! Windows / Linux !! macOS
|-
| New tab || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+T</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+T</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| New window || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+N</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+N</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| New private window || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Shift+P</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+Shift+P</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| Close tab || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+W</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+W</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| Close window || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Shift+W</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+Shift+W</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| Reopen closed tab || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Shift+T</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+Shift+T</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| Next / previous tab || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Tab</syntaxhighlight> / <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Shift+Tab</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Tab</syntaxhighlight> / <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+Shift+Tab</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| Tab 1–8, last tab || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+1</syntaxhighlight> … <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+8</syntaxhighlight>, <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Ctrl+9</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+1</syntaxhighlight> … <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+8</syntaxhighlight>, <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>Cmd+9</syntaxhighlight>
|}

== Mouse shortcuts ==

* Middle-click a '''link''' — opens it in a new tab (in the background).
* Middle-click a '''tab''' — closes it.
* Right-click a tab → '''Pin Tab''' — collapse it to a small icon; pinned tabs stay after restart.
* Right-click a tab → '''Mute Tab''' — silence that tab's audio.
* Drag a tab to reorder it; drag it out of the window to open a separate window.

== about: pages ==

Type these in the address bar like a URL:

{| class="wikitable"
! Page !! What it is
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:config</syntaxhighlight> || advanced preference editor (see below)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:addons</syntaxhighlight> || extensions and themes
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:preferences</syntaxhighlight> || settings; jump to a pane with a fragment: <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>#privacy</syntaxhighlight>, <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>#search</syntaxhighlight>, <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>#sync</syntaxhighlight>
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:logins</syntaxhighlight> || saved passwords
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:downloads</syntaxhighlight> || download history
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:processes</syntaxhighlight> || task manager — CPU and memory per tab and extension (<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:performance</syntaxhighlight> on older versions)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:support</syntaxhighlight> || troubleshooting info; includes the '''Refresh Firefox''' reset button
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:profiles</syntaxhighlight> || manage profiles (create, launch, rename)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:debugging</syntaxhighlight> || debug add-ons, service workers, or Firefox itself
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:memory</syntaxhighlight> || memory reports
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:networking</syntaxhighlight> || network connections and diagnostics
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:sessionrestore</syntaxhighlight> || pick which tabs to restore after a crash
|}

== about:config quick wins ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:config</syntaxhighlight> edits preferences by hand — search for a name, then toggle or set a value.

{| class="wikitable"
! Preference !! What it does
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>browser.privatebrowsing.autostart</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>true</syntaxhighlight> = always start in private mode
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>dom.security.https_only_mode</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>true</syntaxhighlight> = upgrade every connection to HTTPS
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>browser.urlbar.suggest.searches</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>false</syntaxhighlight> = stop search-engine suggestions in the address bar
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>browser.tabs.warnOnClose</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>false</syntaxhighlight> = close a multi-tab window without asking
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>browser.shell.checkDefaultBrowser</syntaxhighlight> || <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>false</syntaxhighlight> = stop the "make Firefox default" prompt
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>general.useragent.override</syntaxhighlight> || set a custom user-agent string (e.g. to masquerade as another browser)
|}

<blockquote>
'''Gotcha:''' changes apply immediately and are not validated — a wrong value can break Firefox. Reset any preference with the ↺ button, and if things go wrong, use '''Refresh Firefox''' on <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>about:support</syntaxhighlight>.
</blockquote>

== Command line ==

Flags work on all platforms; on Windows the executable is <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox.exe</syntaxhighlight>, on macOS run <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>open -a Firefox --args …</syntaxhighlight>.

{| class="wikitable"
! Command !! What it does
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -new-window URL</syntaxhighlight> || open URL in a new window
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -new-tab URL</syntaxhighlight> || open URL in a new tab
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -private-window [URL]</syntaxhighlight> || open a private window (URL optional)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -P "profile"</syntaxhighlight> || start with a specific profile
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -CreateProfile name</syntaxhighlight> || create a new profile
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -ProfileManager</syntaxhighlight> || open the profile picker
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox -safe-mode</syntaxhighlight> || start with add-ons and hardware acceleration off (troubleshooting)
|-
| <syntaxhighlight lang="text" inline>firefox --headless --screenshot out.png URL</syntaxhighlight> || render a page to an image without opening a window
|}
